name: PermiteGenerareSume
description: Verifică dacă este permisă generarea sumelor bancare pentru banca și perioada selectate. Blochează generarea dacă există deja un fișier confirmat.

src.sql:
DECLARE @Banca NVARCHAR(20) =
    UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM('[TknParams:Banca]')));

DECLARE @DataPlatii DATE =
    CAST('[TknParams:DataPlatii]' AS DATE);

DECLARE @TipPlata NVARCHAR(100) =
    LTRIM(RTRIM('[TknParams:TipPlata]'));

DECLARE @CodSucursala NVARCHAR(20) =
    '[GetOrSession:BranchV]';

DECLARE @Anul INT =
    CAST('[GetOrSession:YearV]' AS INT);

DECLARE @Luna INT =
    CAST('[GetOrSession:MonthV]' AS INT);

DECLARE @ExistaConfirmat INT = 0;
DECLARE @ExistaAltTipPlata INT = 0;


-------------------------------------------------
-- Validare cod banca
-------------------------------------------------

IF @Banca NOT IN
(
    'BCR',
    'BRD',
    'BT',
    'CEC',
    'ING',
    'MIL',
    'RZB',
    'UNI'
)
BEGIN
    SELECT -1 AS PermiteGenerare;
    RETURN;
END;


-------------------------------------------------
-- Centralizare sume pentru toate bancile
-------------------------------------------------

;WITH SumeBanci AS
(
    SELECT
        'BCR' AS CodBanca,
        CodSucursala,
        Anul,
        Luna,
        DataPlatii,
        TipPlata,
        Status,
        Valid
    FROM app.SumaBCR

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'BRD',
        CodSucursala,
        Anul,
        Luna,
        DataPlatii,
        TipPlata,
        Status,
        Valid
    FROM app.SumaBRD

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'BT',
        CodSucursala,
        Anul,
        Luna,
        DataPlatii,
        TipPlata,
        Status,
        Valid
    FROM app.SumaBT

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CEC',
        CodSucursala,
        Anul,
        Luna,
        DataPlatii,
        TipPlata,
        Status,
        valid
    FROM app.SumaCEC

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ING',
        CodSucursala,
        Anul,
        Luna,
        DataPlatii,
        TipPlata,
        Status,
        valid
    FROM app.SumaING

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'MIL',
        CodSucursala,
        Anul,
        Luna,
        DataPlatii,
        TipPlata,
        Status,
        Valid
    FROM app.SumaMIL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'RZB',
        CodSucursala,
        Anul,
        Luna,
        DataPlatii,
        TipPlata,
        Status,
        Valid
    FROM app.SumaRZB

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'UNI',
        CodSucursala,
        Anul,
        Luna,
        DataPlatii,
        TipPlata,
        Status,
        valid
    FROM app.SumaUNI
)

SELECT
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Acelasi tip de plata este deja confirmat
    -------------------------------------------------
    @ExistaConfirmat =
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM SumeBanci s
                WHERE s.CodBanca = @Banca
                  AND s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
                  AND s.Anul = @Anul
                  AND s.Luna = @Luna

                  AND CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE)
                      = @DataPlatii

                  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.TipPlata,'')))
                      = @TipPlata

                  AND s.Status in ( 2, 5)
                  AND ISNULL(s.Valid,0) = 1
                  
            )
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Exista alt tip de plata in aceeasi zi
    -------------------------------------------------
    @ExistaAltTipPlata =
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM SumeBanci s
                WHERE s.CodBanca = @Banca
                  AND s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
                  AND s.Anul = @Anul
                  AND s.Luna = @Luna

                  AND CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE)
                      = @DataPlatii

                  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.TipPlata,'')))
                      <> @TipPlata

                  AND ISNULL(s.Status,1) IN (1,2,5)
                  AND ISNULL(s.Valid,0) = 1
            )
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END;


-------------------------------------------------
-- Rezultat token
-------------------------------------------------

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN @ExistaConfirmat = 1
            THEN 0

        WHEN @ExistaAltTipPlata = 1
            THEN 0

        ELSE 1
    END AS PermiteGenerare;
